name: track_then_log
title: First day · "track what I eat" gets a table at once, and "log two eggs" a row

steps.reply:
I've made a **Food log** under a new Food module. It's empty so far. Each entry has what you ate, when, the meal (breakfast, lunch, dinner, snack or drink), the amount, calories and notes.

To add something, tell me in plain words, like "oatmeal with banana for breakfast" or "two slices of pizza at 1pm". I'll file it with today's date and the time you give me, or the current time if you don't give one. If you don't give calories, I'll estimate them and mark them as estimates.

What did you eat today?

Logged two eggs at 11:54 today. I estimated about 143 kcal, assuming large eggs at roughly 72 kcal each. I left the meal blank. Tell me if it was breakfast or brunch, or if the time or size was different, and I'll fix it.
